name: close_document
description: Evict a session and release its lock/memory. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,dirty,discardedRevisions,warning?}: a dirty close warns (dirty:true + warning naming the discarded unsaved revision count) instead of silently discarding; save first when the warning matters. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"dirty":false,"discardedRevisions":0}. Close when finished; expired sessions (30min idle) must be re-opened. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
